name: GQ-009 · The God Questions Observatory
summary: A standing meta-question about how the Great Library should make SISO's highest-value questions visible, composable, continuously revisable, and connected to evidence and approved action.

license.reason: The Work record is question metadata; research inputs, operational receipts, and answer artifacts retain their own rights and publication review.

relationships.context: The Great Library is the public-safe registry and reading surface whose God Questions infrastructure this Work studies and dogfoods.

evidence.summary: The accepted identity model makes questions Works and accepted answers immutable Releases in the Great Library.

relationships.context: Foundry discovers source buckets, repositories, books, people, and watch signals relevant to each question without writing accepted truth.

evidence.summary: The question-driven architecture assigns evidence-universe discovery and monitoring to Foundry.

relationships.context: SISO Knowledge preserves the large rights-aware corpus and retrieval plane that question dossiers reference but do not duplicate.

evidence.summary: The published boundary assigns durable corpus custody, provenance, retrieval, indexes, and graphs to SISO Knowledge.

research_contract.question: How should the Great Library make God Questions visible, composable, continuously updated, and connected to evidence, decisions, approved action, and capability learning without becoming the corpus warehouse or execution runtime?
source_scopes: the existing Frontier Question Works, metadata seeds, answer-lineage model, and question-driven research architecture
the generated Research index and individual Question Work reading surfaces
publication-safe Foundry, Knowledge, Evidence Engine, Event, ADR, Release, and Snapshot interfaces
privacy-safe receipts from real research, routing, repository, book, and implementation work
research_contract.decision_to_change: Which registry fields, Library projections, evidence interfaces, and action-return contracts should become the standard infrastructure for every SISO God Question?
success_criteria: A cold human or agent can find every standing question, its state, decision target, evidence gaps, falsifiers, watch triggers, and current answer lineage from one generated Library surface.
Existing repositories, books, videos, research, and operational receipts can attach to a question through owned evidence systems without being copied into the public registry.
A question can justify a bounded action candidate and later receive a verified learning return without the Library authorizing or executing the action.
At least one repeated mechanism discovered through a question can be evaluated and promoted into its independently owned capability Work.
falsifiers: The design requires a second question registry or central operational database to remain coherent.
The visible dossier accumulates metadata but cannot improve a real research, routing, or investment decision.
Useful evidence cannot be connected without leaking private corpora, machine paths, client data, or operational topology into the public Library.
Maintaining the question contract costs more attention than the repeated research and decision errors it prevents.
evidence_gaps: No evaluated end-to-end user flow yet proves that the portfolio view helps a cold operator choose the next valuable investigation.
Claim, contradiction, assumption, experiment, mandate, observation, and learning-return objects do not yet share one proven cross-system receipt contract.
No three-question cohort yet measures authoring overhead, evidence reuse, decision impact, or capability promotion rate.
watch_triggers: A new God Question cannot express a decision target, falsifier, evidence gap, or refresh condition in the current contract.
Foundry or Knowledge ships a question-addressable export that can replace a manual evidence link.
The first approved experiment returns an Observation Receipt and exposes a missing Library lineage field.
Three heterogeneous questions complete a full research-to-decision loop and justify stabilizing or deleting provisional fields.
research_contract.answer_shape: A versioned God Questions operating architecture with a generated Observatory, machine-readable question-program contract, evidence and action-return interfaces, ownership boundaries, acceptance fixtures, and explicit promotion and kill gates.
research_contract.refresh_policy: Re-answer when a real question cannot use the contract, a source or action interface changes, three-question evaluation evidence lands, or measured operating overhead exceeds the value created.

program.next_useful_work: Measure whether cold readers can reproduce the public estate dispositions without private context, then route one independently adjudicated runtime receipt before expanding the action bridge.

assumptions.statement: The existing Work, Release, Snapshot, and Event spine can support question-program visibility without a second registry.
assumptions.falsifier: A heterogeneous question cannot express and validate its current program or answer lineage without a separate source of identity truth.

assumptions.statement: A compact assumption, evidence, and action-learning projection improves cold-reader reconstruction enough to justify its authoring overhead.
assumptions.falsifier: Cold readers or agents cannot reconstruct a decision path more accurately, or the repeated authoring cost exceeds the errors and rediscovery avoided.

assumptions.statement: Typed public references can connect question demand to returned learning without granting approval, execution, or evidence-adjudication authority to the Library.
assumptions.falsifier: A real action-to-learning chain cannot remain reconstructable unless the Library stores private payloads or represents a proposal as approval or observation as accepted truth.

evidence_connections.relevance_hypothesis: The canonical constitution exposes the minimum identity, ownership, interface, dependency, and falsification rules the substrate must implement.
evidence_connections.summary: The pushed constitution preserves question identity, organ boundaries, action authority, learning proposals, and explicit later or rejected scope.

evidence_connections.relevance_hypothesis: The verified document checkpoint tests whether the existing generator can expose a canonical question-infrastructure reader without a second registry.
evidence_connections.summary: The exact branch checkpoint passed the complete Library gate and published the authored and generated constitution plus Research navigation.

evidence_connections.relevance_hypothesis: The start Event's public bridge evidence tests whether action and learning ownership can be referenced without copying its owner-held design payload.
evidence_connections.summary: The public Event records the typed, approval-gated bridge while the Library remains limited to safe identity and lineage.

evidence_connections.relevance_hypothesis: Independent cold-reader and contract replay test whether the canonical projection improves reconstruction and remains backward compatible.
evidence_connections.summary: Independent cold-reader and contract lanes reconstructed the operator path and verified canonical human and agent projections at the exact pushed checkpoint.

evidence_connections.relevance_hypothesis: The independent privacy adversary tests whether typed public metadata actually prevents owner-held text, topology, credential, timing, or truth-state leakage.
evidence_connections.summary: The privacy lane found that free-text metadata and temporal or truth-state edges needed stronger validation; the mixed receipt is verified observation, not accepted truth.

evidence_connections.relevance_hypothesis: A reviewed public candidate cohort tests whether existing Library identities and explicit no-change or deferral outcomes can absorb estate learning without a second registry or automatic promotion.
evidence_connections.summary: Four public repository observations resolved to two existing Work links, one historical no-change result, and one owner and license-review deferral; no source or registry identity was automatically promoted.

action_learning_links.summary: GQ-009 defines the decision, falsifiers, evidence gaps, and expected answer without authorizing implementation.
The active initiative is represented as a bounded action candidate; approval and execution receipts remain separately owned.
Shaan approved a six-hour bounded infrastructure, verification, and closeout envelope; the private authorization payload remains owner-held and only its digest is public.
The mixed independent observation passed cold-reader and contract reconstruction but failed privacy hardening, producing a bounded repair requirement rather than an accepted answer.
The Learning Return proposes the privacy and temporal repairs now under verification while keeping GQ-009 researching, publishing no Answer Release, and promoting no capability.

Owner-reviewed estate reconciliation supports the existing identity and authority boundaries, records no new Work or inventory, keeps the deferred candidate outside promotion, and proposes no Answer Release.

evidence.summary: The existing six Frontier Question Works, V28 selection, question-driven research documentation, generated Research surface, and live operating-architecture debate were reviewed before adding this dogfood question.
The requested priority is the reusable God Questions Library infrastructure, using existing research as dogfood instead of producing redundant speculative answers.
